system.effect:
Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.EfxmNFWRAWQ8aHQM]
Messiah: Special - Extended Action
Signer: Free Action, Interrupt
Messiah Trigger: A Trainer or Pokémon dies. Signer Trigger: A Trainer or Pokémon is reduced below 0 HP.
Messiah Effect: Your divine powers allow you to intervene, saving the Target’s life. They are set to 5 Injuries that will heal at half the normal rate, and 1 HP. This Feature has one use, plus one additional time for each of the Level 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 Character Advancement Level Milestones that you have reached.
Signer Effect: The Target receives no further injuries after being reduced below 0 HP. If being Knocked Out alone would set them to 10 injuries, they instead are set to 9 Injuries.
